reviews.body:
## Blocking issues

Each item was independently checked and retained only when confirmed.

- **packages/openbkn-business-context/src/client/CliSetupControl.tsx:22** — A detection is started on every change of cliPath, and the resulting 'checking' state is propagated through onBusy into cliBusy, which disables the cliPath input the user is typing into.
  Failure scenario: The user opens 高级设置 and types an absolute path such as /opt/openbkn/bin/openbkn. The first character triggers controller.check, which publishes phase 'checking' synchronously before awaiting the Host call; cliBusy becomes true and the input is committed with disabled=true, so the browser drops focu…

The host-side CLI setup (bounded views, fail-closed install gating, fixed SDK version, no raw installer output crossing the boundary) is solid and well covered by tests. The client wiring regresses the existing cliPath field: every keystroke starts a detection whose 'checking' state disables that same input.


<details><summary>Impact and review coverage</summary>

- Impact: Manual entry of a custom cliPath in 高级设置 becomes unusable, which is the documented recovery path when DSH cannot find the CLI.
- Not covered: Of docs/evidence/cli-setup9-20261010 I read RESULTS.md, EVIDENCE-MANIFEST-adjacent manifests, final-pack.log and the custom-path DOM capture; the remaining per-run JSON/txt/png artifacts were not ope…

</details>

## Items to confirm (nonblocking)

- **packages/openbkn-business-context/src/cli-setup.ts** — Any command other than the literal openbkn is classified custom-path-missing with canInstall:false, including the bare openbkn.cmd that the in-UI hint at OpenBknOverlay.tsx:201 and README tell Windows users to enter, so…
- **packages/openbkn-business-context/tests/cli-setup.test.ts** — The fixture's spawn ignores spec.signal and always settles, so the 5s per-command and 180s install timeouts and the resulting reason 'timeout' have no coverage.

Push fixes or reply `/review` to request another round.
